papers.abstract: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. papers.title: IA-MoE: An Intensity-Aware Mixture of Experts for DNN Inference
papers.abstract: In edge-cloud collaborative inference, the layers of a deep neural network (DNN) are placed on edge and cloud virtual machines (VMs) for every request, while the edge load and the cross-cloud bandwidth change over time. We propose IA-MoE, an intensity-aware Mixture of Experts (MoE) framework that scores each layer-VM pair by end-to-end delay and energy and places the layers one at a time on the best-scoring VM. papers.problem_zh: 这篇论文解决了边缘云协作推理中深度神经网络（DNN）推理的效率问题。
papers.method_zh: 提出了IA-MoE框架，通过动态调整DNN层在边缘和云虚拟机上的分布，优化了推理过程，提升了响应速度。
